# Jordan Barker

> Personal site of Jordan Barker, an AI engineer. Projects in machine learning, data analysis, and computer tinkering.

Writing posts link to plain Markdown versions where one exists. Interactive projects link to live web pages.

## Writing

- [AI Engineer's Approach to Running a Marathon](https://jordanbarker.github.io/projects/marathon.html.md): AI-assisted training plan and race day recap of the Madison Marathon.
- [Receiver Fan Automation](https://jordanbarker.github.io/projects/receiver-fan-automation.html.md): Automating receiver cooling with a 12V trigger, relay, and a data-backed temperature check.
- [RAGBRAI LII Guess the Route Contest](https://jordanbarker.github.io/projects/ragbrai-lii.html): Analyzing past RAGBRAI routes with clustering and a scoring algorithm to predict the 2025 route.

## Interactive projects

- [Termverse](https://jordanbarker.github.io/termverse/): Browser games that teach terminal concepts.
- [Secret Hitler Simulation](https://jordanbarker.github.io/secret-hitler-sim/): A simulation of Secret Hitler showing Bayesian probabilities on the fly.
- [House Affordability Calculator](https://jordanbarker.github.io/marimo-pages/apps/house_affordability.html): An interactive mortgage calculator.
- [Wikipedia Sentiment Analysis Exploration](https://jordanbarker.github.io/projects/wiki-sentiment.html): Visualizing sentiment and emotion model predictions on Wikipedia articles.
- [Reinforcement Learning Pong Agent](https://jordanbarker.github.io/projects/pong.html): Play Pong against a deep Q-learning agent in the browser.

## Tools

- [Space Analyzer](https://github.com/Jordanbarker/space-analyzer): A disk space visualization tool for macOS.

## Reference

- [Data Science Cookbook](https://jordanbarker.github.io/data-science-cookbook/docs/intro.html): Jupyter notebooks covering common data science techniques.
